title: The recorder's Scholar-only entry at Mootcombe reveals a named 'planted guest' (Marl) seated among the elders in ink laid down after the rest of the guest-list had dried — a pointed, specific mystery — but there is no NPC, location, or further menu option anywhere to investigate who Marl was. The only payoff is a single closing-recap line confirming the detail is 'known now', with no in-game way to actually chase it.
